s: The author finds Grok 3's mobile UI preserves markdown, unlike its web UI, making it viable for documentation. They compare LLM biases and over-training issues, particularly with FastAPI vs. FastHTML, and Grok 3's improved understanding of FastHTML compared to other LLMs.
sub: Grok 3 Mobile UI vs. Web UI Markdown Preservation
LLM Over-training and Bias (FastAPI vs. FastHTML)
